selection.basis: The fresh report has 37 image-health-unverified variant gaps. Select nine exact models with nine remote primary image resources; one Twitter Gravel V3 image is shared by two published build variants, so this covers ten health-gap instances. Add one exact Elves Falath R7170 image-exactness check, for ten exact models and eleven frozen gap instances total.

targets.image_exactness_boundary: The TWITTER Gravel V3 2024 RS image may be reclassified only if current exact-option evidence supports the selected Sensah/alloy build; do not infer exactness from successful image loading or a nearby generation.

targets.evidence_only_assignment: one Luna Max agent checks current exact Falath Pro Disc R7170 manufacturer image routes and documented remote-use or reusable-rights terms; no repository edits.

tooling_prerequisite.problem: data:gaps marks every remote primary image as unverified even immediately after image:report has confirmed a successful image response; image:report currently lacks an exact-image filter and machine-readable output.
tooling_prerequisite.change: Add scoped JSON output to image:report, persist a dated per-resource health check on selected image records, and suppress image-health-unverified only when every current remote URL returned an image response within the preceding 30 days. Preserve the gap when a check is absent, stale, blocked, unhealthy, or incomplete.
tooling_prerequisite.tests: Cover exact image filtering, JSON results, fresh healthy suppression, and stale/failed/incomplete checks retaining the gap.
tooling_prerequisite.research_limit: Check only the nine frozen remote image IDs plus any exact Elves asset surfaced by the evidence-only check. Do not fetch the full site image inventory.

research_rules.image_rights: A health response establishes only endpoint response and content type on the check date. It does not establish image subject accuracy, reuse rights, attribution, or future availability. Keep third-party files remote unless reusable rights are documented; preserve the exact model/build, credit, alt text, source and fallback metadata.
research_rules.stop_criteria: Run the bounded image health check once for the frozen resource IDs. For Elves, stop at an exact manufacturer asset with usable rights terms or a concrete identity/rights boundary; do not repeat the prior 50-area sweep.
research_rules.delivery: Local B51 batch only; no push, pull request, merge, publication, or production action.
